# FLIGHTEC

> Southern Africa's specialist partner in mining and mineral exploration, combining unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) with applied geophysics.

FLIGHTEC delivers airborne magnetic, radiometric and topographic surveys, plus borehole wireline logging and data processing, for mining and mineral exploration clients across Southern Africa. Head office in Windhoek, Namibia; Research & Development in Knysna, South Africa.

## Services
- Magnetic Surveys
- Radiometric Surveys
- Topographic Surveys
- Wireline Logging (borehole)
